items.title: Danny Barker — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: No nonsense. I know him real well, like I wanted to call him some time to talk.

ctx.x: No nonsense. I know him real well, like I wanted to call him some time to talk. I didn’t know what to talk to him about, so I just don’t . . . Let’s forget about it.
So you were playing, but you were mainly playing by ear. You weren’t reading music.
